{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for converted customers and exclude invalid ages (e.g., < 0)
converted_customers_valid = sales_df[(sales_df['converted'] == 1) & (sales_df['customer_age'] >= 0)]

# Compute mean age of converted customers with valid ages
mean_age_converted_valid = converted_customers_valid['customer_age'].mean()

# Output the corrected mean age
mean_age_converted_valid"}
